name: Shumoku Kanae
source:
She is the most popular sophomore in the current committee. 

She is not only good-looking, but also has a high level of technique. She wears a relaxed atmosphere and is the kind of older sister that people look up to.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk004/]official site[/url]]
